pro_course_detail.title: IELTS (International English Language Testing System) - English Test Preparation
pro_course_detail.description:
The International English Language Testing System (IELTS) is the world’s most popular English language proficiency test for higher education and global migration, and measures the language proficiency of people who want to study or work where English is used as a language of communication. It uses a nine-band scale to clearly identify levels of proficiency, from non-user (band score 1) through to expert (band score 9).

Why is IELTS important?
More than 10,000 organisations globally trust IELTS, so when you take the test you can be confident that it is recognised by educational institutions, employers, governments and professional bodies around the world.

As one of the pioneers of four skills English language testing 30 years ago, IELTS continues to set the standard for English language testing today. Governments in Australia, Canada, New Zealand and the United Kingdom use IELTS to process immigration applications.

How does IELTS work?
IELTS has been developed by some of the world’s leading language assessment experts and will test the full range of English skills needed for success in your new job or study placement abroad.

You’ll be assessed on the following elements:

Listening
Reading
Writing
Speaking

Choosing the right test:
There are two IELTS tests available – IELTS Academic or IELTS General Training. The test you choose should be based on what it is you want to do.

IELTS Academic - measures whether your level of English language proficiency is suitable for an academic environment. It reflects aspects of academic language and evaluates whether you’re ready to begin training or studying.

IELTS General Training - measures English language proficiency in a practical, everyday context. The tasks and tests reflect both workplace and social situations.

Who owns IELTS?
IELTS is jointly owned by the British Council, IDP: IELTS Australia and Cambridge Assessment English.

pro_course_detail.title: TCF (Test de connaissance du français), TEF (Test d'évaluation de français), DILF (Diplôme initial de langue française), DELF (Diplôme d’études), DALF (Diplôme approfondi) - French Test Preparation
pro_course_detail.description:
TEF Canada is mainly for Canadian citizenship and many university admissions use TEF scores.

TCF Canada is mainly for obtaining permanent residency and is more versatile, for people with various goals (study and work).

The DILF, or "Diplôme initial de langue française", tests the lowest level of French, categorised as A1.1. This level is appropriate for someone just starting to learn French, thus the name of the test: "Initial diploma of the French language". It is predominantly taken by migrants to France with little to no French exposure, particularly those who may not be fully literate in their native tongue. As opposed to the DELF and the DALF, the DILF prioritises spoken and listening communication and comprehension over written and reading communication and comprehension.

The DELF, or "Diplôme d’études en langue française", is the test that will concern most French learners, as it tests levels from A1 through to B2, covering beginner and intermediate learners. Within the DELF category of tests are four different exams. When opting to take the DELF, you will have to choose amongst the DELF A1, DELF A2, DELF B1 or DELF B2 tests, as each test is specially tailored to students of that level. The DELF is one of the most useful diplomas to have, particularly when applying for French jobs or for French university degrees. Most undergraduate and graduate programs require a B2 diploma, though some undergraduate programs accept B1. B1 and B2 are also the levels that most French workplaces require if your job is going to include a moderate amount of French.

The DALF, or "Diplôme approfondi de langue française", is the advanced language diploma. Two DALF tests exist: one for level C1, and the other for level C2. A C1 is required by some master’s and doctorate programs. Earning a C2 diploma usually requires at least several months of immersive learning as well, meaning that someone with a C2 level has likely already attended French university or worked in a French job.

I qualified with a degree in teaching and education from the Manchester Metropolitan University some years ago, and have recently completed an additional Masters in English Language Teaching at the University of Southampton in order to keep my studies up to date. 

I specialise in teaching fluency and achieving confidence in speaking English, and have helped many students pass exams such as the IELTS, Cambridge and Trinity exams. I can also help with all aspects of Business English, especially interview preparation and presentation performance. 

I have a dynamic and enthusiastic approach and can teach any level of comprehension.

I follow italki's 24-hour cancellation / reschedule policy.

teacher_info.about_me: I’m from Northamptonshire, UK, and have a diverse career background. I started as a teacher in Manchester before working in purchasing and import/export for a promotional gift company. Later, I became a Business Analyst for a major insurance company, contributing to a large transformation program and new service launches. I also helped establish a customer contact centre. After moving to Italy, I renewed my credentials with a Master’s in English Language Teaching, blending business experience with a passion for teaching.
teacher_info.about_teacher: As a Business English teacher, I specialize in helping professionals build confidence and fluency in English. I focus on practical communication skills for business settings, including meetings, presentations, interviews, and general conversations. I adopt a dynamic and flexible teaching approach, tailoring lessons to be both engaging and highly relevant to your professional needs. My aim is to make sure every lesson is both useful and interesting, placing your specific goals at the heart of our sessions.
teacher_info.teaching_style: Each lesson I design is personalized to meet your unique goals and objectives. I incorporate a range of materials and resources, ensuring that they are relevant and impactful for you. Whether you prefer to follow a structured course or focus on specific topics you consider a priority, my teaching approach is adaptable. My ultimate focus is on helping you succeed in using English effectively and confidently in your professional life.
teacher_info.cancel_policy: If a student has problems which prevent them attending a lesson it is their responsibility to send me a message before the start time and attempt to reschedule the session. I follow italki's 24-hour cancellation / reschedule policy. If a student does not arrive within the first 10 minutes of a lesson then this will be classed as non-attendance. Please note that lessons will not be held with students in moving vehicles for safety and connectivity reasons.

pro_course_detail.title: Confidence & Fluency
pro_course_detail.description: Practical lessons on a wide variety of topics aimed at developing conversation ability by addressing your functional language and promoting discussion. Practice and improve your speaking skills to improve your confidence and fluency.

pro_course_detail.title: Presentation and Public Speaking Skills
pro_course_detail.description: Become a dynamic speaker. Look, sound, and feel confident in front of an audience. Capture and maintain their attention and deliver engaging presentations. Be prepared for your next speaking opportunity.

pro_course_detail.title: Grammar Focus
pro_course_detail.description: Do you want to improve your English grammar? Do you wish you could speak in more detail, making use of a wider variety of tense and forms? Do you wish you could stop making the same mistakes? Master your grammar, and grow your range of expression.

pro_course_detail.title: English for Work & Business
pro_course_detail.description: Practice and improve your business English with lessons that cover essential skills such as emailing, telephoning, meetings and presentations, and much more! Focus on particular topics that are important to you, personal to your job and business skill area.

pro_course_detail.title: Job interview preparation
pro_course_detail.description: Ace that next interview with some Business English interview lessons. Before the application, get some help to check your CV, cover letter, and get help with all the forms. Before the interview, learn how to answer everything from common to difficult questions in English. You can also learn how to talk about your work experience and career goals, and improve confidence in your presentation to raise your chances of selection!
